items.rationale: The police report is required under §2.3.3, but §§3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) expressly exclude the cost of translating it, so the covered amount is zero.
The translator’s working materials are excluded under §§7.1.8(e)–(f), both as business supplies and as charges ancillary to excluded translation work.

items.description: Robbery settlement for stolen watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported robbery away from home is covered under §§2.3 and 11.1, subject to item evidence under §7.1.10; the pictured Tudor is estimated to reach the €2,500 unscheduled-watch cap, and the cash exceeds its €500 cap. The €5,000 away-from-home limit does not bind, so the estimate is €2,500 + €500 − the single €50 deductible = €2,950.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes forwarding and shipping even when billed alongside a covered property settlement, so the covered amount is zero.
